description: Estimate how much concrete to order. Send a list of pours: slab (length x width x thickness), footing (continuous or pad: length x width x depth), round column or pier (diameter x height) or rectangular column (side_a x side_b x height), each with a count, and a waste percent. units 'us': length, width of a slab and height in feet; thickness, footing width and depth, diameter and column sides in inches. units 'metric': the same big dimensions in metres and the small ones in millimetres. Get back each pour's volume in cubic feet, cubic yards and cubic metres, the total, the total with waste, and, if you send order_increment_yd3 (for example 0.25 or 0.5), the amount to order rounded up to that step. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/concrete-volume). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional job label (your own text, echoed; not an address or a person).

order_increment_yd3.description: Optional: round the order up to this many cubic yards (0.25, 0.5, 1).

pours.description: Pours (up to 100). Each: shape and the dimensions that shape needs, plus count.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'garage slab' (your own text, echoed).

length.description: slab or footing length (ft or m).

shape.description: slab, footing, column_round (pier, sonotube) or column_rect.

side_b.description: rectangular column other side (in or mm).

width.description: slab width (ft or m); footing width (in or mm).

units.description: us (default): feet for length/height and slab width, inches for thickness, footing width/depth, diameter and column sides. metric: metres and millimetres in the same places.

waste_percent.description: Extra to cover spillage, over-excavation and uneven subgrade, in percent (default 0; many estimators use 5 to 10).

name: concrete_volume
title: Concrete Volume Estimate (Slabs, Footings, Columns)
